event.text: Call 911 now, or get someone to take you to the nearest emergency department immediately — do not drive yourself. A sudden "worst headache of my life" with new neck stiffness needs urgent brain imaging to check for bleeding around the brain. Do not wait for a reply here. If anyone is with you, ask them to stay with you and report any drowsiness, confusion, weakness, speech trouble or seizure to the dispatcher, or to call 911 if emergency help has not yet been called.
